extName.description: Extension name. Also used as the parent context menu title

extDescription.message: Summarize selected text or the page with AI from the context menu and view the result in the side panel.

sidePanelEmpty.message: Right-click on a page and choose a summary from "AI Context Menu".

oversizeContent.message: Content: $ORIGINAL$ characters (limit: $LIMIT$). Sending up to the limit is about $TOKENS$ tokens.

oversizeMetadata.message: The title or URL is too long and will be shortened.

statusMaxTokens.message: Stopped early because the output limit was reached

errorAuth.message: The API key is invalid or lacks permission

errorRateLimit.message: Rate limit reached. Please wait and try again

errorOverloaded.message: The provider returned a temporary error

errorEditable.message: Text inside input fields cannot be summarized

errorUnreadablePage.message: This page cannot be read by the extension

errorExcludedDomain.message: This site is excluded in the settings

errorEmptyContent.message: There is no text to summarize

errorTooLarge.message: The page is too large to process

optionsProviderNone.message: Register an API key to choose the provider used for summaries.

optionsInvalidKey.message: The API key format is invalid

optionsStorageNote.message: The API key is stored unencrypted in this browser (chrome.storage.local) and is sent only to the $PROVIDER$ API. We recommend using a key with a spending limit.

optionsDataNote.message: When you summarize, the page title, URL (without query or fragment) and content are sent to the AI provider you selected (Anthropic or OpenAI). Data is sent only when you click a menu item or a button such as Regenerate.

optionsExcludedDescription.message: On matching sites, page content is never read or sent (including when the site is embedded in another page). *.example.com matches example.com and its subdomains. Up to $MAX$ entries.

optionsExcludedInvalid.message: These lines are not valid domains: $LINES$

optionsExcludedTooMany.message: You can exclude up to $MAX$ domains

optionsSyncItemQuota.message: This exceeds the storage limit. Reduce the number or length of entries

optionsSyncTotalQuota.message: Synced settings exceed the total storage limit. Remove settings you no longer need

confirmTitle.message: Send this content to the AI?

optionsModelDefault.message: Default: $MODEL$. You can also enter a model name that is not in the list.

optionsModelNeedsKey.message: An API key is required to load the model list

optionsModelInvalid.message: Enter a model name (up to 200 characters)

optionsModelNotInList.message: Saved, but "$MODEL$" is not in the list of available models. Please check the model name

optionsModelUnverified.message: Saved. The model list could not be loaded, so the model has not been verified

optionsModelOutputCapped.message: Saved. This model can output up to $LIMIT$ tokens, so the maximum output tokens will be limited to this value

optionsMaxInputCharsHint.message: $MIN$–$MAX$. If the content is longer, you will be asked before anything is sent (it is never truncated silently).

optionsMaxOutputTokensHint.message: $MIN$–$MAX$. Values above the output limit of the selected models cannot be saved.

optionsConfirmNever.message: Never (still asks when over the limit)

optionsRangeError.message: $LABEL$ must be an integer from $MIN$ to $MAX$

optionsOutputLimitExceeded.message: The maximum output tokens exceed the output limit of $MODEL$ ($LIMIT$)
